title: PublicWithinEffectChanged
description:
`public_within_effect_changed` — a `public_within` row started or stopped conferring, without
being opened or closed. The cause is liveness (a team on the path was deleted or restored) or
policy (the instance switch, a forbid, or a pool team under the anchor). Both the team and the
anchor are `subject` references.

act.description: The admin event type of the act that caused the change, such as `team_lifecycle_changed`.

act_ref.description: The correlation id shared by the causing act's records, when it has one.

PublicWithinCause.description: Why a row's effect changed, in a [`PublicWithinEffectChanged`] record.

oneOf.description: The team, the anchor, or every live path between them, was soft-deleted or restored.
The instance switch, a forbid above the team, or a pool team under the anchor.

PublicWithinEffect.description: Whether a `public_within` row confers, in a [`PublicWithinEffectChanged`] record.

oneOf.description: The row confers reading on the anchor's subtree.
The row exists and confers nothing until its cause is undone.
